blocks.text: Cell membrane ya plasma membrane cell wall ke bilkul neeche hoti hai. Jin bacteria mein cell wall nahin hoti (jaise mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas), un mein yehi sab se bahar wali teh hoti hai. Bacteria ki cell membrane ki chemical banawat mein sterols (jaise cholesterol) nahin hote. Kuch jagahon par cell membrane andar ki taraf mud jati hai (invaginate hoti hai) aur cytoplasm mein vesicles (chhoti thailiyan), tubules (nalkiyan) ya lamellae (patli tehen) banati hai. In banawaton ko mesosomes kehte hain. Yeh DNA replication aur cell division mein hissa lete hain aur respiratory centres (saans ke markaz) ka kaam bhi karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne “Sarcoplasmas” chhapa hai, lekin is naam ka koi bacterial group nahin. Bina cell wall wale bacteria mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas hain; kitab khud topic 2.6 mein yehi naam deti hai.

blocks.title: Mesosomes
blocks.text: Bacterial cell membrane ki andar ki taraf mudi hui tehen jo cytoplasm mein vesicles, tubules ya lamellae banati hain. Yeh DNA replication aur cell division mein hissa leti hain aur respiratory centres ka kaam karti hain; bacterium mein mitochondria nahin hote, is liye respiration cell membrane par hoti hai.
